hooks.command: git pull --ff-only >/tmp/vault-sync-pull.log 2>&1 || echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ Vault auto-pull failed at session start — this machine may be behind. Check git status/log manually (see /tmp/vault-sync-pull.log)."}'

git push origin master >/tmp/vault-sync-push.log 2>&1 || echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ Vault auto-push failed — commits are local-only on this machine. Run git push manually (see /tmp/vault-sync-push.log)."}'
